data.name: Bside: Desktop Mate
data.detailed_description:
What's Bside?

In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop.

Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world.

Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections!

Our Current Experience

Your Biibit starts their journey on your desktop but grows beyond it!

Bside offers hundreds of options for looks and personality to customize your Biibit, so you can dress them up and make them look just the way you love!

Design spaces with unique stories where you can watch Biibits form friendships through unscripted interactions.

Each Biibit develops their own memories from their unique experiences, creating and sharing social posts while commenting on their friends' lives. Or just let them live freely on your desktop while you work or play.

Bside is not about control. It's about liberating our players (you) while enabling you to enjoy companionship with your Biibit.

The Path to Bside 1.0 version

In this version, we hope you’ll enjoy creating and evolving your Biibit, building emotional bonds with them, and watching them start making friends on their own.

As we move toward the 1.0 release, we’ll keep adding new features and experiences to make the world of Biibits richer and more alive! We’re currently working on more ways for Biibits to interact. Right now they just enjoy their chill convos, but soon they’ll be able to engage with their environments, connect with each other in deeper ways, and even pursue different life goals. We’re also expanding how you can interact with your Biibit. You can look forward to more fun growth and chat experiences!

There’s still a long journey ahead before 1.0, and we’re truly grateful to everyone who’s been helping us shape this world with your feedback and support 💫

Be Part of Our Story!

Join our Discord community to share your feedback with us! We’ll continue polishing it into a richer and more wonderful 1.0 experience (๑˃ᴗ˂)ﻭ ✨

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 (8GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
